# Wave quantization per tile: v27 stream-K against v9_tile data-parallel

M = 4096, N = 256 .. 16384, bf16, back to back (HIP graph), 2 GB of rotating inputs, rocprof median of 100 dispatches ([sweep.py](../sweep.py) WQ4096 / WQ8192). `dp`: v9_tile at the tile; `cap`: v27 at the tile as deployed (capped policy; a data-parallel choice of one wave or less runs v9_tile); `all`: v27's one-tile split over all 256 programs (v9_tile §13's sk256).
